A LITTLE PRACTICE GOES A LONG WAY

Find your release.

Pull the stone back to set power. Move sideways to aim. Release as the angle and body markers cross their green bands. Sideways pull aims in the opposite direction, like a slingshot.

A harder throw travels farther, but the timing is tighter. A flat release keeps your stone skipping.

Keyboard
1–7 choose a stone · ← → aim · ↑ ↓ power
Space prepares, then throws · Esc cancels or pauses

Each stone and timing mode has its own best. Friend challenges use the same conditions. Boat points reward targets; skip records stay separate. Records stay on this device.

Music: Yoga Sounds by FluxFM. The music button starts live radio; sound effects have their own toggle.
